svg.title: Typed pay items: bonuses, deductions and one-off payments — SoftTrack web design mockup (#297)
svg.desc: A line on a payroll run is a person’s compensation and one adjustment, an amount with a note, so a bonus and the repayment of an advance in the same month are one number. A line carries several items, each with a type, an amount and a note; recurring items live with the compensation; and approval freezes them.
